claims.notes: [BATCH NOTE b088] This file covers ONLY lines 1-156 of results/deployment-oracle-2026-06-06/deployment-oracle-findings.md; a sibling batch (b089) covers lines 157-274. Batch-level scope decisions: dates, timestamps, session numbers (Session 104/105/106), git commit hashes, section cross-references (§1, §§3-4, §4b, § Changelog), the line-number citation "its lines 406-407" at line 135, and model names (`gemini-3-flash`) are out of C4 scope per instrument rule 5. Vote-threshold strings used purely as row/column labels or condition names ("k3", "k4", "3-of-5", "4-of-5", "5-of-5", "2-of-5", "vote=2", "vote=3", "vote≥3", "1-of-N", "T0.3", "T0.7") are treated as names; the underlying vote threshold and pass count ARE extracted once, where the Headline asserts them as the configuration that was run (lines 12-15). Buffer radii that only identify which metric a number belongs to ("corrected F1 @ 50 m", "F1 @ 20 m", the 75-150 m ring labels) are treated as context rather than claims, following the 078 precedent; the 487-tile Era 2 corpus size IS extracted because it is asserted as a fact. The rank column of the § 3 table (ranks 1-4) is an ordinal row label, not a measured quantity, and is not extracted. Anchor note: this document's own directory holds no map count, so the 55-map corpus size is anchored to the sibling diagnostic summary that records n_maps.
